mapper.sql: WITH user_subjects AS (SELECT 'USER' AS sub_type, #{userId} AS sub_id, #{userId} AS user_id UNION ALL SELECT 'DEPT' AS sub_type, dc.ancestor_id AS sub_id, ud.user_id AS user_id FROM user_dept ud JOIN dept_closure dc ON ud.dept_id = dc.descendant_id JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = ud.dept_id AND d.status = 1 JOIN sys_dept da ON da.id = dc.ancestor_id AND da.status = 1 WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId} AND ud.status IN (1, 2) UNION ALL SELECT 'POST' AS sub_type, up.post_id AS sub_id, up.user_id AS user_id FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON sp.id = up.post_id AND sp.status = 1 WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.status IN (1, 2))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_dept ud INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = ud.dept_id WHERE ud.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_post up INNER JOIN sys_post sp ON sp.id = up.post_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE r.status = 1
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleCode}, '%')
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleName}, '%')
) t

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE r.status = 1
AND r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleCode}, '%')
AND r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.roleName}, '%')
ORDER BY r.role_code

, all_role_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE r.status = 1 ) SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT p.id FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_ids ar ON rp.role_id = ar.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.status = 1
AND p.permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionCode}, '%')
AND p.permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionName}, '%')
) t

, all_role_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT r.id AS role_id FROM grant_table gt JOIN user_subjects us ON gt.subject_type = us.sub_type AND gt.subject_id = us.sub_id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = gt.role_id WHERE r.status = 1 ) SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.status FROM sys_role_permission rp JOIN all_role_ids ar ON rp.role_id = ar.role_id JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE p.status = 1
AND p.permission_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionCode}, '%')
AND p.permission_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.permissionName}, '%')
ORDER BY p.permission_code
